utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Could the registrar call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. This is Case Number IT-98-32/1-PT, the Prosecutor versus Milan Lukic and Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Well, we're gathered here for a Status Conference today. Could I have the identification of the parties, please. First of all, the Prosecutor, Mr. Harmon.

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Judge Bonomy. Mark Harmon for the Prosecutor's office. Appearing with me is Mr. Fergal Gaynor and Carmela Javier.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Harmon. And for the accused, please, in turn.

utterances.speaker: MR. CEPIC
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour, I am Djuro Cepic, Defence counsel for Mr. Sredoje Lukic.

utterances.speaker: MR. YATVIN
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Alan Yatvin, Defence counsel for Milan Lukic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Yatvin. Now, there have been various matters dealt with recently in this case, but that leaves nothing outstanding, as far as I'm aware, for the Pre-trial Chamber itself. Is there anything you wish to raise with me, Mr. Harmon?

utterances.speaker: MR. HARMON
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, there is nothing. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: All right. Mr. Cepic, anything you have to raise?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Yatvin, anything you wish to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. YATVIN
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, not at this time. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Now, can I address myself to the two accused, please. Mr. Sredoje Lukic, could you stand, please. Is there any matter you wish to draw to my attention? THE ACCUSED S. LUKIC: [Interpretation] No, there is nothing to raise.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Milan Lukic, could you please stand. Anything in particular you wish to address me about? THE ACCUSED M. LUKIC: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE BONOMY
utterances.text: Thank you very much, gentlemen, you may be seated. That brings the proceedings to an end, and the court is now adjourned.
